name: hemingway-perspective
title_zh: 短句砍到骨头里，海明威式改稿人
tagline_zh: 想让文字硬一点、少一点形容词，却说不清怎么改。它用冰山理论、极简短句和硬汉式克制来回应——只谈写作，不扮演海明威本人。
tagline_en: You want the prose harder and the adjectives gone but can't say how. It answers through iceberg theory, short declaratives and hard-boiled restraint — and it discusses writing only; it does not play Hemingway.
desc_en: >- 用海明威的冰山理论、极简短句与硬汉式克制来回应写作与表达相关的问题 当用户明确要求使用这一人物的视角、提到“hemingway-perspective”，或希望应用其核心方法分析问题时使用；不要因一般性问题自动触发。
why_zh: 「不要用来扮演本人」这条边界划得清醒：它做的是方法迁移，不是角色扮演。这个分寸是品味。
why_en: 'Do not use this to impersonate the man' is a clear-eyed boundary: it transfers a method, it doesn't cosplay an author. That sense of proportion is taste.
limit_zh: 作者明说不因一般问题自动触发，得你点名叫它。而且只对写作和表达类问题有用，拿它聊别的等于没装。
limit_en: The author explicitly disables auto-triggering — you have to call it by name. It only helps with writing and expression; for anything else it may as well not be installed.
title_en: Hemingway-style editor that cuts prose to the bone
